resources.string: Open the Report tab, choose a category, say where it happened and what you saw, add a photo if you like, then tap Submit. Reports are anonymous and are checked by a moderator before anything appears on the map.
High risk (coral), medium risk (amber), low risk (green). A pin with a white centre and a coloured outline is unverified: it has not been confirmed yet, so treat it with care.

Your name and email are never attached to a report or shown to anyone. The app keeps a random device session ID so you can track your own reports, and your approximate location so a moderator can place an approved report on the map. Neither is shown to other residents.

Every report starts as Pending review. A moderator checks it, then approves it (it becomes a public hotspot with a severity the moderator chooses) or rejects it (it is kept on file but never shown). The Map and Alerts tabs only show approved hotspots.
SafeZone does not contact or dispatch emergency services. If you are in danger, call.

If you create an account: your name and email. If you submit a report: its category, area, description, an optional photo, your approximate location at the moment you submit, and a random device session ID.
Only approved hotspots appear to other residents: category, area, severity, time and the description. Your name, email, session ID, photo and exact location are never shown to residents.
Moderators see the report text, photo and captured location so they can verify and place it. They do not see your name or email on a report.
